title: How landings are scored: the road to 100 out of 100
dek: Eleven parts, each with a tight window for full marks, and the ranks they add up to.
description: How Fly Kai Tak scores a landing out of 100: sink rate, touchdown point, glidepath, centreline and more, plus the ranks from Cadet to Captain.
hero_alt: The result screen after a landing on Runway 13: grade B, a score out of 100, the two parts that lost the most points, and new rows for glidepath error, approach track, speed control and rollout centreline.
hero_caption: The result screen shows where the points went.

zh.title: 降落點樣計分：邁向 100 分之路
zh.dek: 十一個部分，每個部分都要喺窄窄範圍內先得滿分，加埋就決定你嘅級別。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 點樣以 100 分為滿分計降落分數：下沉率、著陸點、下滑道、中線等等，仲有由見習生到機長嘅級別。
zh.hero_alt: 喺 13 跑道降落之後嘅成績畫面：B 級、百分制分數、失分最多嘅兩個部分，仲有下滑道誤差、進場航跡、速度控制同滑跑中線嘅新項目。
zh.hero_caption: 成績畫面會顯示分數喺邊度失咗。
